baseline_targets.name: File mutation, resource locks, journal, undo
contracts: dry-run is read-only
writes carry backup and journal records
hash compare-and-swap guards commit and undo
undo blocks drift, missing backup, duplicate undo, and corrupt journal
canonical resource locks are deterministic
baseline_targets.current_quality: 68/68 file, mutation-safety, and session-lock tests passed. Direct mutation and recovery oracles are strong, including backup jail, drift, journal corruption, and restricted-context checks. No mutation-testing score exists.
baseline_targets.expected_bar: A mutation test must prove no applied file state can survive without a valid journal record and no undo can overwrite changed content. Concurrency claims need independent processes with shared real paths.
not_measured: full command-contract matrix for all file aliases

baseline_targets.name: Scaffold update, bootstrap/init, rollback, provenance
contracts: check, preview, and dry-run do not write
real apply requires approval and session/task/reason metadata
update re-plans under the global lock
rollback requires batch, reason, current hashes, and valid backups
bootstrap/init stage, validate, commit, and restore the exact target on failure
baseline_targets.current_quality: 63/63 update/bootstrap tests and 17/17 filtered kernel front-door tests passed. Fault injection, target locks, replan hooks, rollback, provenance, symlink safety, and dry-run write protection are covered. The concurrency tests are not a full independent-process update/bootstrap race matrix.
baseline_targets.expected_bar: Every real apply path must leave either the original target or a journaled recoverable commit. Two independent processes must not commit from one stale plan.
commands: bun test cli/tests/update-command.test.ts cli/tests/bootstrap.test.ts cli/tests/bootstrap-conflicts.test.ts cli/tests/bootstrap-cleanup.test.ts

baseline_targets.name: Generated contracts, downstream payload, JSON envelopes, release surface
contracts: one approval decision for every real write
one stable afol.result/v1 JSON error envelope for covered JSON callers
registry/help/generated manifest parity
downstream template payload parity
baseline_targets.current_quality: 38/38 registry/operation-context tests, 41/41 help/template tests, and manifest:check passed. These oracles validate registry metadata and root/template equality, but not tools.json semantic parity or all restricted front-door mutators.
baseline_targets.expected_bar: A catalog test must compare live command and subcommand semantics to every agent-facing catalog. A restricted front-door test must prove denial and no write for each mutating command family. JSON tests must assert exactly one parseable envelope on stdout and no plain error on stderr.
not_measured: JSON error behavior before project-root detection
typecheck, release validation, security scans, and full suite
